answer: Identity bonds that decay stop bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a bond worth twice its expected 30-day earnings, marked by a violet seal. It melts 5% per epoch unless the agent does verified work, so idle or rented identities fade. Forging 100 identities means locking 100 bonds, 6000 coins, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards. A tundra agent renews likewise, and fake-attestation loops wind the cost spiral tighter.
